roadmap.next: Recover the complete map and lesson transition table before accepting the Tutorial as accurate.

requirements.current: Loot, equipment and realm entry work in the selected journey. Historical reward supply, bypass and repeat-entry rules remain unresolved.

requirements.title: Seven ordinary class journeys
requirements.target: Independently verify creation, starting equipment, weapons, ability, growth, loot, death and reconnect for each class.

requirements.title: Movement, terrain and collisions
requirements.target: Match speed, sliding, occupancy, lava, directional push and negative terrain cases.
requirements.current: Movement, terrain and collision have reconstructed server paths. Exact original authority and edge behavior remain unresolved.

requirements.title: Weapons, spells and projectiles
requirements.target: Match attack cadence, damage rolls, spread, trajectories, hit shapes and retirement.
requirements.current: Native Wizard combat and Priest starter Light Heal work; three Priest heals have code/prepared coverage. All five quivers have partial implementation evidence: Tattered normal public native paid-arrow combat; Reinforced, Iron, Steel and Golden PREPARED private native coverage, not earned acquisition. Steel is ordinary first-hit; Iron/Golden continuation is reconstruction, not historical production proof. Longer public movement still produced movement-budget Error20/pose drift; bounded short-input recovery does not establish general movement acceptance. Wooden0a08 alone adds partial Knight paid-Shoot evidence in a PREPARED HP500 cohort with genuinely prepared Archer10 unlock, not ordinary acquisition or public Knight acceptance. DEF+2 already worked; Iron/higher shields remain unsupported. Its 200ms terminal/delayed retirement does not guarantee a full sweep. Current Netcup nonreproduction does not resolve the earlier movement-budget diagnosis. Other abilities/projectiles and original server rules remain unverified.

requirements.title: Conditions and their lifecycle
requirements.target: Match client effects, wire representation, authoritative application, stacking and expiry for every original condition.
requirements.current: Sticky client Dead has narrow self-view recovery. Enemy Slowed and Paralyzed are partial: Tattered/Reinforced/Iron Slowed0.5 and Steel/Golden Paralyzed0 movement have tested overwrite3s, independent aging/precedence, whole-step expiry/cleanup and PREPARED private native clear/resume. Public HP5 deaths do not prove duration. Wooden adds partial enemy Stunned7/mask64: new NPC shots suppressed while movement and clocks continue, unlike Slowed/Paralyzed movement effects; independent overwrite3s timers clear explicitly. PREPARED private both-stream native suppression/movement/clear/resume is not ordinary public Wooden proof. Enemy timing is reconstruction, not recovered historical AI; Player conditions, original rules/history and full class journeys remain unverified.
